description.value: Bean Around The World is a long-established Vancouver coffee chain (the brand references a 35-year anniversary) with a café at the corner of Main Street and 10th Avenue. The location offers both indoor and outdoor seating along a well-traveled urban cycling corridor. The parent company roasts its own beans out of North Vancouver and operates multiple locations across the city.
